name: Precision 350m — Exact Altitude + Minimal Drift
description: Reach exactly 350m and land as close to the launch pad as possible. Motor: Cesaroni 163H133-14A (163 Ns, 29mm, 0.190 kg, 1.2s burn). Body: 50mm OD (r=0.025m) CFRP, 4mm radial clearance over motor. Strategy: s0_ballast (GA range 0-1.0 kg) deadweights the rocket into the 350m apogee corridor — estimates show ~0.8 kg ballast hits this band. Recovery: since apogee < MAIN_DEPLOY_ALT (500m), only the drogue deploys (28 m/s descent) — intentionally faster descent minimizes wind-driven drift, aligning with the minimize-flight_time proxy. flight_time minimize is the mathematical proxy for landing distance from base. Stability judged at Mach 0.3 only — this rocket stays well subsonic throughout.
_calibration_note: With windturbulence=0.0: GUI 24.12 matches headless 23.09 (~0m offset). Target 350m directly. Previous note (turbulence=0.1) had -1m GUI offset.

seeds._comment: Final bisection champion (2026-07-02). Ballast precision-converged. Headless quanta: 349.968m / 350.005m — both display as 350m in OR GUI 24.12. windturbulence=0.0, dt=0.005s.
